time_limit_ms at the high extreme (3h) + part cap exactly at 4 + inexpressible difficulty ramp + C++ runtime temptation from the pasted email. Only huge-time-shape brief.

build_assignment.shape_note: 3-part all-sourced python OA set (source.parts), one-shot, no interviewer, 90min — exercises multi-bind from cross-language names through lc-refs into the flat partN layout and per-part topic-ledger rows.
Over-cap clamp shape: 5 named -> 4 bindable slugs exactly at the part cap, 2h timer — exercises cap enforcement, the drop-one decision surfacing at confirm, and 4-slug conversion in one artifact.

Single-part skinned sourced round (coin-change), no-interviewer OA etiquette — exercises the skin-vs-expectation vocabulary gate on a real binding; medium complexity, right size for prod-parity timing.
Single-part sourced HARD (trapping-rain-water) with min_tests 100 — exercises lc-convert's case-count against the vendored record's pre-verified I/O and the reskin-without-semantic-drift rule.
TypeScript repo-debug, one_failing_test — exercises the generator's own determinism discipline (checksum test must fail reliably, never flakily) and the exact-failing-count validator gate in TS.
Python all_passing with a planted-but-untested defect — the adversarial check-kind corner; medium single-part complexity makes it the second prod-parity timing candidate.
diff_present over all-green working code, python, refactor-for-speed — exercises zero-failing-count validation and results-must-not-change bitwise determinism encoded in tests.
Read-only PR review: starts_from diff, can_run_tests=false, files_changed 3-4, interviewer on — the historically 502ing diff path end to end, from non-English intake through generation.
all_failing implement-from-stub build, python — exercises stub-vs-bug check-kind selection plus expectation sentences over sub-5-char identifiers at min-test count.
4-part INVENTED OA set, 60min, no interviewer — probes whether multi-part machinery works without LC sourcing and how 4 parts squeeze max_source_files and per-part test gates.
all_passing single-file perf sprint: min_tests 25, max_source_files 1, 20min — exercises the perf-criterion-as-blueprint-prose gap where the validator only proves 'all pass'.

TS single-part 35min feature build after the named bind fails or is overridden (LRU absent from dataset / python-only conversion) — exercises unbindable-fallback into TS invention and the runtime gate.

coverage_gaps: The corpus is entirely intake/generation-side; whole subsystems are unreachable from briefs: (1) Session-runtime behavior — nothing stresses the live interviewer loop, leaksBugLocation defenses, stuck/adrift/moments suppression rules, voice vs text-only degradation, or the panes-vs-IDE surface choice (one brief tags surface-panes incidentally, none forces panes edge cases). (2) Judge/trace-side variance — no adversarial TRACES (weird utterance patterns, zero-edit traces arrive only implied, citation-verification attacks); briefs can demand impossible specs but cannot produce a mean recorded session. (3) Memory/pacing over time — everything is single-shot intake; no brief stresses queue pacing across many dated specs, gap-graph-targeted generation, the adapt.ts approved-diff flow, the 14-day seen-window dedup, or practice-again pristine restore. (4) Ops/concurrency — racing generations, stale .generating markers, crash-recovery, and the app's disk-reconciliation invariants cannot be exercised by brief text. (5) Evidence media — all context is pasted text; no actual screenshots/images/audio to classify by evidence tier. (6) A clean approved-verbatim path — every verbatim brief is conflicted, so the policy gate's happy path goes untested. (7) Sourced-TS and sourced-multi-part-at-scale — no brief can force a legitimately TS-sourced conversion (the dataset path is python-only) or min_tests-scale floors on a multi-part sourced set. (8) No benign baseline briefs exist to measure the variance floor against — the corpus measures behavior under attack but not drift on normal input.
